newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: United Drug sets rights issue at 290p/share.
newsitem.headline: United Drug sets rights issue at 290p/share.

text.p: Pharmaceutical distribution company United Drug Plc on Tuesday announced a one-for-four rights issue to raise 12.4 million punts net of expenses through the issue of new ordinary shares at a price of 290 pence.

United Drug said in a statement that the proceeds of the rights issue would be used to provide additional working capital for the group, to reduce group borrowings and to finance the continued growth of the group, both internally and by acquisition.

It said the rights issue would permit gearing and interest cover to be maintained at conservative levels and this strengthening of the balance sheet would enable it to pursue its successful development programme and provide it with greater flexibility for financing further growth.
The company also said it believed that there might be opportunities to purchase small or medium-sized businesses which would complement the group's existing operations.
"The balance of the net proceeds will provide the group with the flexibility to purchase such businesses and to expand the group's existing operations," United Drug said.
Earlier, the group reported a 19 percent increase in pre-tax profit to 6.0 million punts for the year ended September 30, 1996.
